# opnsense_firewall_outbound_nat_settings (Resource)

Outbound NAT mode (**Firewall ▸ NAT ▸ Outbound**). Manual rules are `opnsense_firewall_nat` resources. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `firewall_outbound_nat_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_firewall_outbound_nat_settings.this
  id = "firewall_outbound_nat_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_firewall_outbound_nat_settings" "this" {
  mode = "hybrid"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `mode` (String) Outbound NAT mode: `automatic` (rules generated for every interface), `hybrid` (generated rules plus manual ones), `advanced` (manual rules only) or `disabled`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `firewall_outbound_nat_settings`.
